records.issue_text: Controller specs for add_members/remove_member inject group_id directly into the params hash instead of going through real route/URL parsing, masking the routing/param-name mismatch and letting broken tests pass
records.rationale: The finding hinges on a “routing/param-name mismatch” (i.e., route would yield `:id` while specs pass `group_id`). In the diff, the admin routes add `delete "members"` / `put "members"` inside `resources :groups` without `on: :member`, which in Rails generates a nested-style param (`:group_id`) for `/admin/groups/:group_id/members`. records.issue_text: limit param in groups_controller members action is read from client input with no upper bound, allowing unbounded query size
records.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, `limit` is derived directly from `params[:limit]` (`limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`) and then used in `group.users...limit(limit)` with no maximum cap. This allows a client to request an arbitrarily large `limit`, potentially causing expensive/unbounded queries and resource exhaustion.
